create_usd_mesh: create a USD mesh object from a MuJoCo model mesh geometry with textures and materials
build_primitive_mesh: build a USD primitive mesh from a MuJoCo geom configuration with UV mapping support
create_tendon_mesh: create a USD tendon mesh composed of cylinder and hemisphere primitives from MuJoCo model
update_usd_object_transform: update the position, orientation, visibility, and scale of a USD object across animation frames
attach_image_material: attach a textured image material with BSDF shader to a USD mesh prim
